months.8: In the dry season Lake Manyara shrinks and waterbirds concentrate at the few remaining pools in Tarangire. Resident raptors, including Bateleurs and Martial Eagles, are frequently seen soaring over the plains.

months.3: Spring migration begins, bringing warblers and swallows to the valleys. California Quail become more vocal in the vineyards, and Brown Pelicans are seen along the Sonoma coast.
months.7: Summer heat slows inland birding, though Western Bluebirds are still occasionally spotted in the oak woodlands. Jenner and the Russian River mouth provide regular sightings of Brown Pelicans.

luangprabang.overview: River Lapwings and Small Pratincoles forage along the exposed sandbanks of the Mekong River, a dependable dry-season sight. The country holds over 700 bird species, though heavy hunting pressure makes forest birds elusive. Forest patches around Kuang Si Falls reward patient birders.
